name: Claude (Product)
description: Verified app, desktop, mobile, and add-in launches from Claude.
headline: Verified Claude product launches across {days} days.
subtitle: October 2025 — May 2026. Claude app and product releases from official Claude Help sources.
footnote: Cross-checked on May 9, 2026 against official Claude Help Center release notes and Claude product blog.

releases.title: Per-project Styles in Claude.ai
releases.description: Claude.ai added per-project Styles, letting Pro and Max users pin a default style (formal, concise, exploratory, code-heavy) per project so every conversation in that project inherits it.

releases.title: Claude iOS share extension
releases.description: Claude for iOS shipped a system Share extension so users can send web pages, screenshots, and files into a new or existing chat from Safari, Photos, or Files.

releases.title: Claude Desktop on Windows GA
releases.description: Anthropic promoted Claude Desktop for Windows to GA with MSI deployment, enterprise SSO via SAML, and parity with the macOS app on shortcuts and global capture.

releases.title: Project files revamp
releases.description: Claude Projects added file upload, search, and per-file pin controls with smarter chunking, so large reference docs stay quotable across many threads.

releases.title: Claude voice mode on iOS and Android
releases.description: Claude mobile apps shipped voice mode with three voices, hands-free turn detection, and live transcript view, available to Free, Pro, and Max users.

releases.title: Cowork research preview on Claude Desktop
releases.whatChanged: Desktop app adds a dedicated Cowork space for multi-step work on your files and tools.
releases.description: Anthropic introduced Cowork as an agentic desktop workspace for knowledge work beyond coding, initially available to Max plan users on macOS.

prerequisites: Research preview available in your region/plan
steps: Open Claude Desktop and switch to the Cowork experience.
Connect or select the folders and tools Cowork should use.
Describe the outcome you want; iterate on drafts and file changes in the thread.

releases.title: Claude Code for VS Code 1.0
releases.description: Claude Code for VS Code reached 1.0 with chat panel, inline edit mode, terminal-attached agent mode, and a /resume command for picking up long-running tasks across sessions.

releases.title: Interactive connectors and MCP Apps
releases.description: Claude gained interactive connectors that can render and operate live app interfaces in chat.

releases.title: Claude for PowerPoint
releases.description: Claude shipped as a PowerPoint add-in for drafting, editing, and restructuring slide decks.

releases.title: Claude for Jira and Confluence
releases.description: Claude shipped first-party Jira Cloud and Confluence Cloud connectors with grounded retrieval, scoped permissions, and a Today in Jira morning digest in Claude.ai.

releases.title: Cowork research preview on Windows
releases.description: Cowork research preview expanded to Claude Desktop on Windows for Max users, with parity on file system access, plugin invocation, and computer use opt-in.

releases.title: Cowork enterprise plugins launch
releases.description: 13 enterprise connectors added (Google Workspace, DocuSign, FactSet, Apollo, Harvey, and more), plus admin controls, group spend limits, and prebuilt plugin templates for finance, HR, engineering, and design.

releases.title: Claude for Slack 2.0
releases.description: Claude for Slack 2.0 added thread-aware summarization, /ask shortcuts, channel-level memory toggles, and per-workspace data residency picker for Team and Enterprise plans.

releases.title: Chat search and memory for free users
releases.description: Memory from chat history expanded beyond paid plans to all Claude users.

releases.title: Claude for Android tablets and foldables
releases.description: Claude for Android shipped a re-flowed two-pane layout for tablets and foldables, including persistent project sidebar, drag-and-drop file upload, and stylus-friendly canvas.

releases.title: Claude for Excel and PowerPoint work across apps
releases.description: Claude began sharing full context across open Excel and PowerPoint workflows.

releases.title: Custom visuals in chat
releases.description: Claude started generating interactive charts, diagrams, and visual explanations inline in chat.

releases.title: Persistent Cowork thread from mobile (Dispatch)
releases.description: Pro and Max users got a persistent Cowork thread manageable from Claude mobile: pair iPhone to Mac via QR code, send tasks from mobile, and return to finished work on the desktop.

releases.title: Claude Code for JetBrains GA
releases.description: Claude Code reached GA on the JetBrains plugin marketplace for IntelliJ, PyCharm, GoLand, and WebStorm with chat panel, inline edits, an agent terminal, and shared MCP server registry with the VS Code extension.

releases.title: Computer use in Cowork and Claude Code
releases.description: Claude introduced computer use in research preview for Cowork and Claude Code, allowing on-device clicks, navigation, and tool execution from desktop workflows.

releases.title: Inline image generation on mobile
releases.description: Claude mobile apps gained inline image generation through Claude Design with download, share-sheet integration, and per-region safety controls for Free and Pro plans.

releases.title: Cowork Dispatch for Android
releases.description: Cowork Dispatch arrived on Android, allowing Pro and Max users to send tasks from their phone to a paired Mac or Windows desktop and watch progress from their pocket.

releases.title: Cowork GA: computer use, analytics, and enterprise controls
releases.description: Claude release notes announced Cowork GA on macOS and Windows for paid plans, with enterprise analytics and access-control enhancements.

releases.title: Claude Code CLI 1.1 with subagents
releases.description: Claude Code CLI 1.1 added named subagents, a /plan + /act flow, persistent project memory, and a hardened sandbox profile for shell command execution on macOS and Linux.

releases.title: Claude Opus 4.7 available in all consumer products
releases.description: Opus 4.7 launched across Claude consumer products with gains in coding, higher-resolution image understanding, and stronger instruction following; Claude Code raised default effort to xhigh and added a /ultrareview slash command for Pro/Max.

releases.title: Claude Design research preview from Anthropic Labs
releases.description: Anthropic Labs launched Claude Design in research preview for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users, pairing a chat panel with a canvas to generate and iterate on designs, prototypes, slides, and one-pagers with automatic design-system pickup and exports to PDF, PPTX, HTML, Canva, and Claude Code.

releases.title: Claude Design Figma export
releases.description: Claude Design added Figma export so a generated prototype can be opened as an editable Figma file, preserving frames, auto-layout, components, and a styles map back to the source design system.

releases.title: Mobile offline drafts for Claude apps
releases.description: Claude iOS and Android apps now support offline draft capture and sync-on-reconnect for long-form prompts and notes.

releases.title: Claude for Google Docs add-on
releases.description: Claude shipped a Google Docs add-on with sidebar drafting, edit-in-place revision, and comment thread responses, available to Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans on Workspace.

releases.title: Cowork Shared Rooms for Team and Enterprise
releases.description: Cowork Shared Rooms let Team and Enterprise users invite teammates into the same Cowork session, with role-based observe/edit permissions, shared file scopes, and an audit timeline for admins.

releases.title: Claude Design React + Tailwind export
releases.description: Claude Design added one-click React + Tailwind export with shadcn-aligned components, optional Storybook stories, and a /push-to-claude-code shortcut that opens the project directly in Claude Code.

releases.title: Claude Code watch mode for tests
releases.description: Claude Code introduced watch mode: it tails your test runner output, auto-proposes fixes for newly failing tests, and runs them in a sandboxed worktree before opening a PR.
